principle: Split only where the daily loop would route differently, and only with a rubric signal plus retagged units. Do not add the child to the live graph until the starter set has items and a starter-scoped frontier router.

child.title: Answer by distinguishing cases
child.statement: You can recognize when a response answers an objection by showing the sources apply to different cases, not by denying the objection.

sourceContexts.ref: Rambam, Hilchot Deot 1:4–5 (the middle path distinguished from extremes)

child.teachingMove: Ask whether the response denies the pressure or splits the case — if two sources both stand, name the fact that keeps them from colliding.
checks: Given an objection and a reply, say whether the reply distinguishes cases or rejects the objection.
child.transfer: In an unseen sugya or responsum, mark a distinction-answer and name the two cases it separates.
child.repair: Write the objection as "these two sources conflict," then ask what fact would make both true.

starterSet.whenImplementing: add as the 30th starter skill (documented cap)
starterSet.whyNotFrozen: a starter-scoped Today would not pick a frozen child, so the daily loop would not route differently

retag.why: Asks what kind of response this is; correct answer is a distinction that shows the sources may not conflict.
Toolkit teach: a difference may resolve a problem by showing the sources apply in different situations.
Names the reasoning move: a distinction that explains why similar cases differ.
The reply distinguishes two related practices rather than denying the concern — deny vs distinguish.

deferredChildren.whyNotNow: No REINTERPRET mode in content. INTERPRETATION/CONCEPT steps are middot, aggadah, and close reading — not one move.
No SECOND ANSWER mode. SECOND SOURCE already maps to fnd-arg-evidence-role.

starterScopedAfterResponse.why: Both children sit on the L5 frontier; alphabetical id prefers resolve-distinction over unresolved.

liveFullGraphAfterResponseClosure.why: Unscoped picker sorts by layer then id; frozen L2 still wins. Implementing the child would not move live Today.
